findings.evidence: The RDF/XML declares the same resources as both owl:Class and owl:NamedIndividual.
findings.explanation: Using the same entities simultaneously as classes and named individuals increases modeling complexity and may reduce maintainability unless intentional.
findings.suggested_fix: Review whether each resource should represent only a class or only an individual, and retain dual typing only where it is explicitly intended.
findings.additional_comment: Aggregated finding covering all detected occurrences.
